sections.appearance: Fubuki has navy blue and light blue hair and vibrant red eyes, her hair is styled into twintails with fitting bangs. Halo ==== Fubuki's halo is made up of a pink-white cross with four outward hearts, all seemingly drawn from one contorted line. Uniform ==== Fubuki wears the traditional uniform of a female police officer, but any formality that it holds is ruined by all the other additions: A baggy overcoat with bright pink accessories and giant hot pink rubber shoes. She also has a traditional police cap on her head. Firearm ==== She uses a black and white Ruger Mini-14 rifle with a pink 30-round magazine, a bipod, a laser pointer attached to the barrel, and a forward-mounted scope.

sections.personality: Fubuki is incredibly lazy. She really does not like working and is happy on days when she can just slack off. Fubuki is often trying to find ways to avoid work, even when there's a crime going on. Most of her time is spent loafing around or complaining about work. She's capable of being appropriately serious every now and then, but it doesn't hold up very long and she eventually returns to lazing around. The number one way to motivate her is to grab her interest with a reward of holidays or even lazing around right after the job is done.
